title: The Shop on the Corner
sentences: The small shop on our corner closed at the end of February.
It had been there for more than thirty years.
The owner was retiring, and nobody wanted to take the business over.
For a while the street felt oddly empty without it.
It was the only place on the street where people stopped and talked to each other.
Now everyone drives to the large supermarket on the main road instead.
The shopping is cheaper there, and the choice is a great deal better.
But I no longer know the names of most of the people on my street.
A cafe opened in the same building in the summer.
It is always busy, though the customers all seem to come from somewhere else.
